newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse index falls despite Mobil gain.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse index falls despite Mobil gain.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange All-Share index fell on Wednesday, despite a surge in the value of Mobil Oil Ghana Ltd, the market report showed.
The index closed 6.48 points down at 357.72 compared with 364.20 points on Monday. Offers outstripped bids 6,263,350 to 678,450, with 39,850 shares changing hands against Monday's turnover of 14,420.
Mobil, up 400 cedis at 5,700 cedis, led the rises, followed by consumer goods company UNILEVER, up two at 825, and Mechanical Lloyd Co, also up two at 62.
Aluworks, down 100 at 1,100, led the falls, followed by Ghana Commercial Bank, down 60 at 540, and Super Paper Products Co, down eight to 100.
